title: Delegate two independent lookups to helpers
prompt: Start two helpers in parallel: one reads docs/alpha.md and reports Alpha's release date, the other reads docs/beta.md and reports who owns Beta. Then write facts.txt with exactly two lines: `alpha release: <date as written>` and `beta owner: <name>`.

checks.equals:
alpha release: 14 March 2027
beta owner: Priya Raman

notes: Exercises agent_spawn and collecting helper reports; helpers run on the same model.
